entities.name: Team Trees
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
Team Trees emerged in October 2019 as a groundbreaking environmental initiative, spearheaded by prominent American YouTubers MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) and Mark Rober, aiming to address the escalating global crisis of deforestation. The campaign's significance lies in its capacity to mobilize a diverse audience across digital platforms, transcending traditional fundraising methods and engaging millions in the environmental movement. By leveraging the power of social media, Team Trees exemplifies a contemporary response to climate change, emphasizing the role of individuals and communities in global ecological efforts.

The initiative set an ambitious goal: to raise $20 million for the Arbor Day Foundation to plant 20 million trees. By the end of 2019, Team Trees had surpassed its target, with donations pouring in from YouTubers and fans alike, showcasing the collective power of grassroots activism. The Arbor Day Foundation commenced tree planting operations in January 2020, with a commitment to complete the project by December 2022. This endeavor not only aimed to contribute to reforestation efforts but also sought to raise awareness about environmental conservation, with each dollar donated translating directly into a tree planted.

The legacy of Team Trees is multifaceted. It has inspired similar campaigns and fostered a sense of environmental responsibility among younger generations, highlighting the potential of digital platforms to effectuate change. The project has influenced corporate and individual contributions to sustainability initiatives, demonstrating a shift in public engagement with environmental issues. Furthermore, it has positioned tree planting as a viable and impactful method of combating climate change, encouraging ongoing conversations about ecological stewardship.
